llm_response.reason: The website claims to offer a wide variety of products (ranging from home appliances to fashion, electronics, pet goods, rental items, etc.) with a focus on 'free shipping,' long delivery periods due to overseas/parallel imports, vague blame-shifting disclaimers, and minimal company identification. There is ambiguity regarding payment and return policies, and core navigation such as links to company info, contact, or policy pages are absent or nonfunctional. No proper business address, registration, or contact details are disclosed, failing to meet fundamental requirements for a legitimate e-commerce operation. All these are classic signs of a scam online shopping site targeting users through low accountability and free/discount claims.
